definitions.explanation: A spray of water for washing the body, or the fixture that produces it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧シャワー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{浴|あ}びた→浴びる：02844_abiru⟧。
examples.english: I took a shower in the morning.
The hot water stopped coming out of the shower.
I wash off sweat in the shower after exercising.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{二回|にかい}→二回：27625_nikai⟧シャワー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{浴|あ}びること→浴びる：02844_abiru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: In summer, I sometimes take a shower twice a day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、お⟦{風呂|ふろ}→風呂：14633_furo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧シャワー⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{洗|あら}ってから→洗う：00827_arau⟧⟦{湯船|ゆぶね}→湯船：13322_yubune⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦つかる→浸かる：13290_tsukaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦マナー→マナー：11139_manaa⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: In Japan, the custom is to wash your body with the shower before soaking in the bathtub.

notes:
From English "shower": both the fixture and the act of showering.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- シャワー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{浴|あ}びる→浴びる：02844_abiru⟧: to take a shower
- シャワー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ / ⟦{止|と}める→止める：00678_tomeru⟧: to turn the shower on / off
- シャワー⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{汗|あせ}→汗：02173_ase⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{流|なが}す→流す：01968_nagasu⟧: to rinse off sweat in the shower
- シャワー⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{済|す}ませる→済ませる：02121_sumaseru⟧: to make do with a shower (instead of a bath)

CULTURAL NOTE:
In a Japanese bathroom (⟦{浴室|よくしつ}→浴室：05301_yokushitsu⟧) the shower is beside the tub. You wash with it first and then get into the bath (⟦{湯船|ゆぶね}→湯船：13322_yubune⟧) to soak, so the bathwater stays clean for the rest of the household. Many people shower only in summer or when busy.
